SirAvladam, I am directed to forward herewith a letter received from the Govemment of Telangana(copy enclosed) regarding the Young India Sports Fellowship (YISF), an ll-month residential Post-Graduate Diploma programme in Sports Leadership and Management proposed to be launched by the Young India Physical Education and Sports University (YIPESU). 2. The Government of Telangana has informed that, under its vision of establishing Hyderabad as a global hub for innovation, excellence and human development, the University has been established with the mandate of creating a world-class ecosystem for sports education, research, leadership and high-performance athlete development. In this context, the Young India Sports Fellowship has been conceived as one of the flagship initiatives of the University. 3. As per the communication, the Young India Sports Fellowship (YISF) is an 1l-month residential Post-Graduate Diploma programme in Sports Leadership and Management. The programme has been designed with the objective of developing a cadre of professionally trained sports administrators, coaches, managers and leaders who can contribute towards strengthening India's sporting ecosystem in line with the national aspiration of positioning India among the leading sporting nations by the 2036 Olympic Games. 4. The programme has reportedly been designed by drawing upon international best practices and is proposed to be delivered with the support of eminent practitioners, distinguished academicians and leading intemational institutional partners. The programme is intended to cater to officials, coaches, administrators and professionals associated with Govemment Departments, sports federations and allied organisations. 5. The Fellowship also provides a potential career pathway for former sportspersons who, despite possessing talent and experience, could not continue their competitive sporting careers due to various circumstances. Through structured education and professional training in areas such as sports leadership, governance and management, the programme seeks to enable such sportspersons to continue contributing meaningfully to the development of sports in the country. The Government of Telangana has accordingly requested that the information relating to the Young India Sports Fellowship may be widely disseminated among interested and eligible sportspersons, coaches, officials and other personnel associated with the concerned organisations, so that eligible candidates may avail themselves of this opportunity. It has further requested that the information may be circulated among officers, affiliated units, districts, member institutions and eligible personnel through appropriate means, including internal circulars, notices, official websites and social media channels, as considered appropriate. A brief note on the Fellowship programme, including the eligibility criteria and mode of application, has been enclosed by the Government of Telangana for ready reference and further circulation. Additional details, including the prospectus and admission timelines, frdY be obtained through the official channels of YIPESU, as indicated in the communication. In view of the above, the enclosed communication along with the brief note on the Young India Sports Fellowship is forwarded for information and wide dissemination amongst the concerned officers, institutions, affiliated organisations, sportspersons, coaches, sports administrators and other eligible personnel, with a view to enabling interested and eligible candidates to take advantage of the Fellowship programme within the stipulated admission cycle. It is requested that the enclosed information may kindly be circulated amongst the concerned stakeholders through appropriate official channels and brought to the notice of eligible candidates for information and necessary action at their end.
